_comment: World-side player-facing strings: examine labels + examine bodies. Tier doctrine lives in docs/design/insight_revelation_system.md (two-stage reveal pattern). Cosmology words (soul, imprint, dissolved, Acheron, sangue, etc.) belong at tier-2 ONLY; tier-1 is observational, tier-0 is sensory.
